1.title: A Spurned Schumer Reaches Out to the Left
1.summary: In a phone call this week, the Democratic leader told the new Michigan Senate nominee who had opposed him to just win, working to foster unity ahead of a difficult race.

2.title: How the U.S. Is Aiming for Regime Change in Cuba
2.summary: Our reporter Julian E. Barnes, who covers U.S. intelligence agencies, describes how the Trump administration has been looking for a current or former Cuban official to take over the island’s government.

3.title: Max Miller Continues to Resist Pressure to Drop Out as Deadline Looms
3.summary: The Republican House member from Ohio was accused of holding a gun to his ex-wife’s head and fracturing the collarbone of their young daughter. He has denied the accusations.

4.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
4.summary: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from neighbouring Morocco into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

5.title: Hunter Biden tells BBC his pardon was 'not good' for America or his father's legacy
5.summary: In a wide-ranging BBC interview, the former president's son denied having any interest in running for office and said his father's cancer has spread.

6.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
6.summary: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.
